@@U03485@@
now it’s a peak! What a tremendous crash that was! A monstrous rock fell from the moon, squashing, killing friend and foe alike and no questions asked. But how can I not admire the art, the skill, that brought that mountain into being from below and above— in a single night!

@@U03487@@
Settle down! It was all a fantasy! Good riddance to that nasty brood! It’s a good thing, though, that you weren't their king. But now we're off to the great sea festival! They welcome and honor there strange and wondrous guests.

@@U03488@@
(They withdraw.)

@@U03490@@
(Climbing up the opposite side.)

@@U03491@@
So here I am, clambering up steep rocky ledges, stumbling over roots of ancient oaks! In my 哈尔茨 mountains there’s a resinous mist in the air with a soupcon of pitch in it— a smell I dearly love, next after sulfur. Among these Greeks one scarcely gets a whiff of it. But I’m curious to know what they use to stoke their Hellfires.

@@U03493@@
Back home you may have had native shrewdness, but here you're at a loss.
translation:
@@U03485@@
现在是巅峰！那是一场多么巨大的车祸啊！一块巨大的岩石从月球上坠落，压碎了朋友和敌人，没有任何疑问。但我怎能不钦佩那座山从下到上——在一夜之间——的艺术和技巧！

@@U03487@@
安定下来！这一切都是幻想！祝你摆脱那个可恶的窝！不过，你不是他们的国王，这是一件好事。但现在我们要去参加大海节了！他们欢迎并尊敬那些陌生而奇妙的客人。

@@U03488@@
（他们撤退了。）

@@U03490@@
（从对面爬上去。）

@@U03491@@
所以我就在这里，爬上陡峭的岩石壁架，绊倒在古老的橡树根上！在我居住的哈尔茨山区，空气中弥漫着树脂般的雾气，里面夹杂着一碗沥青——我非常喜欢这种味道，仅次于硫磺味。在这些希腊人中，几乎没有人闻到过这种味道。但我很好奇他们用什么来点燃地狱之火。

@@U03493@@
在家里你可能有天生的精明，但在这里你却不知所措。
